statements.text: I was grateful to introduce the bipartisan U.S.-Israel Future of Warfare Act of 2023, which provides for collaboration between the two countries in the areas of defense, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and directed energy.
statements.context: House floor speech celebrating Israel's 75th anniversary, in which Rep. Joe Wilson highlights his bipartisan legislation on U.S.-Israel defense technology cooperation.

statements.text: Grateful to introduce the United States-Israel Defense Partnership Act as HR 1229. This critical legislation will deepen our bilateral defense cooperation to counter unmanned systems, artificial intelligence, and quantum. We must work together to protect American families! https://t.co/cBYMD96CZB

And then indeed, all of this really relates to another issue, and that is that with AI or energy or whatever, we’re dealing with an enemy that is military-civilian fusion of industry. And so every company is a state-owned company.

statements.text: I'm really counting on people who are very knowledgeable. I'm not on that issue. I really respect people who are in the field, but I do see, from my perspective, what I've seen AI so far has been substantially very good. It produces efficiency and can create jobs. I see the positive.

Grateful to cosponsor @GOPPolicy Chairman @JayObernolte’s Frontier Act which is a smart bipartisan framework to spur continued AI innovation with sensible regulation to eliminate catastrophic risk.

I’m grateful for Chairman Obernolte’s incredible work as @GOPPolicy Chairman.

America has led the world in technological innovation for well over 100 years — from the airplane, to nuclear energy, the internet and beyond, and it is vital to national security that America lead in artificial intelligence as well. [...] AI can provide a large boost to economic productivity to the benefit of American families, and we cannot allow China to win the global AI race. I am grateful that the House of Representatives has just passed the “Ratepayer Protection Act,” which protects American ratepayers from higher costs associated with energy demands of data centers and large-load technology infrastructure.

statements.text: My colleagues and I will continue to work closely with the private sector in limiting the ability of bad actors to use this technology to do harm through numerous pieces of legislation that are advancing through the committee process and await further consideration.
